name: Inselstadt
description: The old town island between the arms of the Regnitz, home to the iconic Altes Rathaus, the Little Venice fishermen's row, pedestrian shopping lanes, and countless taverns. This is postcard Bamberg: cobbled, historic, lively, and endlessly walkable, if also the most touristed and most expensive corner of the city.
bestFor: Nomads who want to live in the heart of the action
pros: Walk everywhere, from cafes to taverns to the river
Stunning UNESCO surroundings and riverside atmosphere
Best selection of restaurants and bars at your door
cons: Priciest and tightest rental market in town
Tourist crowds and festival noise in peak season

name: Bergstadt
description: The historic upper town rising to the cathedral, the Old Court, and the New Residence with its rose garden. Steep, atmospheric streets, grand architecture, and sweeping views define this district. It is calmer and more residential than the island below, favoured by those who want history without the busiest crowds.
bestFor: Those who love history, views, and a quieter pace
pros: Beautiful historic streets and hilltop views
Quieter and more residential than the island
Close to the cathedral, gardens, and museums
cons: Steep, hilly walks can be tiring daily
Limited nightlife and fewer everyday shops

name: Gärtnerstadt
description: Bamberg's historic market-gardener district, still dotted with working plots, greenhouses, and long garden strips that earned it UNESCO recognition alongside the old town. Traditional houses line straight streets east of the centre, giving a green, down-to-earth, distinctly local feel that many visitors never explore.
bestFor: Nomads wanting local character and greenery
pros: Walkable to the centre within minutes
cons: Quieter evenings with less going on

name: Wunderburg
description: A traditional, unpretentious residential quarter south of the centre, long associated with brewing and working-class Bamberg. It offers everyday shops, neighbourhood taverns, and a real sense of local life away from the tourist core, with easier and often more affordable housing.
bestFor: Longer stays on a sensible budget
cons: A short walk or bus ride from the old town
Less scenic than the historic centre
